entries.en:
Qhoterl Pasol is despairing at the workers' clumsiness.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Underground caverns can be frightfully dangerous, you know! The workers are constantly tripping over and grazing their snouts and whatnot.
entries.fr: Intérieur des cavernes être très sombre et plein d'aspérités<nbsp>! Beaucouuup d'explorateurs glisser, tomber et se faire bobo bobo<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
地下洞窟の内部は暗く、凹凸も数多いとか～。
そのため、探索に出た者たちは、転んだりひっかけたりと、
頻繁に傷を負っているのでございまする～！
entries.de: Unter Erde ist dunkel und überall liegen Steine herum. Oft stolpern Grabende Pfoten und schlagen Arme und Beine auf.
entries.speaker: QHOTERLPASOL
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Thankfully, the Viis were kind enough to share a recipe for a salve that works wonders for scrapes and cuts. If you're not terribly busy, I was wondering if you'd help gather some of the necessary ingredients?
entries.fr: Heu<->reu<->se<->ment, belles et grandes Viis avoir enseigné à Qitari secrets de fabrication de médicament très efficace<nbsp>! Nécessaire pouvoir être récupéré dans forêt, alors <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)> aller chercher<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ヴィース族から教えてもらったのですが、
この辺りの森でも、傷薬の材料が採れるのだとか～。
負傷者のために、採ってきてくださいましな～。
entries.de: Viis haben Qhoterl beigebracht, wie man Wundsalbe herstellt. Dafür braucht Qhoterl Zutaten!
entries.speaker: QHOTERLPASOL
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: I can tell by the spring in your step you've met with some success. Come along then, let's see what you've brought me!
entries.fr: Avoir rapporté de quoi faire médicament<nbsp>? Qhoterl Pasol avoir hâte de commencer préparation<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
お待ちしておりました～。
目当てのものは、手に入りましたので～？
entries.de: Ah, da bist du ja! Hast du, was Qhoterl für die Wundsalbe braucht?
entries.speaker: QHOTERLPASOL
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Splendid! With this, I'll have a fresh batch of ointment ready in no time at all, though I cannot help but feel that, in this case, prevention would be better than cure.
entries.fr: Bravo bravo<nbsp>! Pouvoir soigner bobos des Qitari maintenant, et surtout de mari quand glisser et casser figure<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ありがとうございまする～！
これで生傷の絶えぬ夫たちも、
一安心というところでございましょ～！
entries.de: Vielen Dank! Daraus kann Qhoterl wirkungsvolle Wundsalbe für Grabende Pfoten machen.
entries.speaker: QHOTERLPASOL
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Perhaps if the workers could refrain from injuring themselves at every given opportunity, there wouldn't be such high demand for the stuff. Until then, I may have need to call on your talents again!
entries.fr: Bientôt, Qhoterl Pasol commencer recette de produuuit de beauté aussi<nbsp>! Mais pas partager<nbsp>! Garder secrète et devenir plus belle Qitari, hi hi hi<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ところで、この近辺では他にも良薬が採れるとか～。
その中には、わたくし向けの美容薬になるものも……
あら、今の話は秘密にしてくださいましな～。
entries.de: Übrigens gibt es in Gegend noch andere Naturschätze. Sind Geheimnis von Qhoterls Schönheit! Aber behalte Geheimnis für dich, ja?
